creators.name: Nick Dekker (Breakfast With Nick) — 'Dr. Breakfast', Columbus food/travel writer
creators.credible: IG @breakfastwithnick 32K followers / 8,201 posts; running the Breakfast With Nick blog since 2007; bylines in Columbus Monthly, Columbus Dispatch, Ohio Magazine, The Kitchn; leads brunch tours for Columbus Food Adventures. Deep, findable per-place Columbus content.

creators.name: Columbus Food Adventures / alt.eats.columbus (Bethia Woolf & Andy Dehus)
creators.credible: 62K IG; USA Today 10Best 'Best Food Tour in the U.S.' 2024; 15 years of tours; grew out of the original alt.eats.columbus and tacotruckscolumbus sites — the authority on Columbus ethnic/hidden-gem eats and the taco-truck scene.

creators.name: Anthony O'Connell (614feast) — Columbus food creator & podcaster
creators.credible: ~34K IG plus the '614 feast' podcast interviewing Columbus restaurateurs and foodies. Columbus-based; NOTE his separate @upperfeast (95K) is a NYC/Upper-East-Side account — the Columbus-scope account is @614feast.

creators.name: Dan Wyatt (Ohio Foodie 614)
creators.credible: 31K IG / 792 posts; steady Columbus restaurant reviews and new-opening alerts ('occasional trips outside Columbus' but Columbus-centered).

creators.name: Alina & Kate (Tasting Columbus)
creators.credible: 31K IG / 1,728 posts; long-running Columbus food-blogger duo covering where to eat & explore in Columbus.

creators.name: Katy (& Reanna) — columbus_foodie, Columbus RNs
creators.credible: Two Columbus RNs (Katy Thompson, co-founded with Reanna) photographing the Columbus food scene; ~50K IG. Featured in Spoon University / Shoutout Ohio round-ups of Columbus food bloggers.

creators.name: Hollen Campbell (Eating in the 614)
creators.credible: 23K IG / 876 posts; blogging & Instagramming Columbus eats since 2016; Columbus food/lifestyle/events, social-media manager at a local venue.
